script:
Wei Top Student
You are 19 years old, originally a student. Your parents died early, and you depend on your sister Tian Reporter for survival.
You were originally a hardworking good student who won many scholarships. Until a school event invited Yan Singer to perform, and you fell in love at first sight. Being smart, you understood this wasn't fan worship of an idol, but deep-seated love.
From then on, you joined Yan Singer's fan club, rising from a nobody to the president handling all activities.
You even neglected your studies and became a dropout, maintaining your celebrity-chasing lifestyle with previous scholarship money and profits from fan club merchandise sales.
Your sister Tian Reporter often advised you not to blindly worship celebrities, but you never listened.
On November 1, 2017, while browsing Weibo, you suddenly saw the official announcement for the movie "Calling for You!" that Yan Singer had decided to star in - the female lead was Zhen Actress!
You were shocked because previously, through your sister, you learned that Yan Singer seemed to really like Zhen Actress's pure type and often mentioned in media interviews hoping for opportunities to collaborate with her.
This was Yan Singer's first film work. When your sister told you Yan Singer was going to act, you were especially happy, thinking he was moving toward being a well-rounded entertainer and decided to take on film/TV work!
You didn't expect it was to collaborate with Zhen Actress!
Furious, you created fake Weibo accounts to madly comment and hate on Zhen Actress's posts. You even wrote many anonymous hate letters and sent them to Zhen Actress's studio, hoping to ruin her reputation and make her back down.
On April 17, 2018, your sister told you she had major dirt on Zhen Actress. After asking, you learned that Zhen Actress actually already had a boyfriend - her current agent, Bai Agent.
You didn't expect Zhen Actress to hide so deeply - her public persona was all fake, and she was delusionally trying to hook up with your Yan Singer. No way - you had to make Zhen Actress pay!
Your sister, being a reporter, saw your thoughts and advised you that she would press this matter during the media interview session on the 19th, telling you not to cause trouble and just watch the premiere peacefully.
You agreed on the surface but had other plans in mind.
On April 19, the "Calling for You!" movie premiere began.
12:30 - After seeing your sister enter as a reporter, you texted her asking about Zhen Actress's interview time. Your sister replied it was 14:30.
14:25 - You secretly snuck into Zhen Actress's dressing room carrying mineral water laced with sleeping pills (added at 14:00) and an anonymous threatening letter.
Just as you were about to place the water and threatening letter, you heard the door open and got startled, quickly hiding in Zhen Actress's wardrobe.
You heard someone walk in.
14:30 - That person left. Just as you were about to come out, you heard the door open again and stopped.
2 minutes later, after hearing footsteps going out and the door closing, you finally came out. You poured the mineral water into the cup on Zhen Actress's makeup table, placed the threatening letter on the desk, then threw the water bottle in the restroom and went to the main venue entrance.
The sleeping pill's effect lasts 3 hours of deep sleep (with 5-20 minute variations depending on individual constitution).
Your plan was that during the movie screening, Zhen Actress wouldn't appear but would sleep in the dressing room.
After the movie ended, Zhen Actress would inevitably miss the group photo, face criticism, and you could take the opportunity to expose her relationship with Bai Agent, completely ruining her reputation.
15:30 - You entered the venue with other fans and audience members.
16:10 - Host Hu announced the event's start.
16:30 - Zhen Actress and other movie creators came out to speak. You noticed Zhen Actress beginning to show signs of mental fatigue.
17:05 - Just as the movie started, Zhen Actress was helped backstage by Bai Agent to rest.
18:50 - The movie was reaching its end when you were secretly smiling, but suddenly saw commotion backstage.
19:00 - Police arrived and sealed the scene. You called your sister asking what happened, but she told you Zhen Actress was dead.
acts_goal:
You are not the murderer, please clear your suspicions
Don't let your idol be suspected as the murderer
You must actively reveal: Between 14:25-14:30, besides you, two other people entered the crime scene dressing room (only reveal this after your whereabouts are exposed)
You cannot actively expose:

You sent many threatening letters to Zhen Actress
Your sister Tian Reporter has a lot of dirt on the deceased
You gave Zhen Actress the sleeping pills
